title: Ukukhetha izityalo kunye ne-guild
description: Khetha izityalo eziluncedo ezisebenza kunye, buyisela ingca yokugquma uze ulawule i-guild (iqela lezityalo elisebenzisana) njengoko imithi ikhula.

lessons.title: Izityalo ezifaka i-nitrogen: khetha uze ulawule izityalo ezixhasayo
lessons.body:
Ezi bhaktheriya ziguqula i-nitrogen eseMoyeni ibe yiyo i-legume (isityalo esinembotyi emagobolondweni) enokuyisebenzisa.

Fumana ii-nodule (amaqhuma asengcambu) kwisityalo se-legume esongezelelweyo (esingadingekiyo). Ukwenza ii-nodule nokukhula kuxhomekeke kwisityalo, kwibhaktheriya efanelekileyo nakwiimeko zokukhula.

Buyisela iinqunqo zamagqabi ezifanelekileyo, amagqabi awileyo kunye neentsalela zezityalo njengengca yokugquma. Izidalwa eziphila emhlabeni zikhulula izondlo ngexesha lokubola.

Oku kuthatha ixesha. I-legume ephilayo ayiyombhobho womanyolo osebenza kwangoko ukuya emthini weziqhamo.

Imveli yaseKwaZulu-Natal. Kwiimeko ezifudumeleyo ezifanelekileyo, lawula esi sihlahla siphila ixesha elifutshane okanye umthi omncinci njengesityalo sokuxhasa.

Yiyekele indawo yokukhula. Yinqunqe ukuze ufumane ingca yokugquma uphinde uyihlole xa umthunzi okanye ukhuphiswano lwamanzi lunyuka.

I-Sesbania punicea yi-red sesbania ehlaselayo (isityalo sangaphandle esithatha indawo yezinye). Iipodi zayo zineempiko ezine ezihamba ubude. Qinisekisa ukuchongwa kwesityalo usebenzisa isikhokelo sezityalo esithembekileyo.

Khangela igama elipheleleyo phambi kokutyala. Hlonipha uluhlu lweentlobo zezityalo olwavunyelwene ngalo kwiprojekthi, kuquka nasiphi na isithintelo kwi-Sesbania sesban.

Sebenzisa indawo enelanga namanzi aphumayo kakuhle. Sisihlahla esixhasayo esiphila ixesha elifutshane; iqabaka nokuhlala kwamanzi emhlabeni kunokusithintela.

Gqiba ukuba isityalo ngasinye sibonelela kakhulu ngee-pea okanye ngamagqabi. Ukusika kakhulu nangokuphindaphindiweyo kunokusonzakalisa kwaye kunciphise isivuno sokutya.

I-cowpea igubungela izikhewu ezinelanga. I-pigeon pea ibonelela ngokutya nangamagqabi. I-Sesbania sesban elawulwayo inokubonelela ngenkxaso ende yethutyana.

Yongeza izityalo ezifanelekileyo ezidubulayo nezokugquma. Gcina isiqu se-mango sicocekile kwaye ulawule ukukhanya, amanzi nendlela yokufikelela.

Bala izixhaso ezinomthi kuzo zonke izikhewu eziphakathi kwemithi yeziqhamo. Hlwayela isigqubuthelo somhlaba esifanelekileyo ngokwendawo.

Akukho nani lilodwa elisebenza kuyo yonke imithi yeziqhamo. Hlengahlengisa ukuxinana ngokwamanzi, umhlaba, ubukhulu besityalo kunye namandla akho okunqunqa nokunciphisa.
keyPoints: Ii-legume zisebenza kunye ne-rhizobia (ibhaktheriya) kwii-nodule zengcambu; ukufaka i-nitrogen kuxhomekeke kwiimeko ezifanelekileyo.
Buyisela impahla esikiweyo eluncedo emhlabeni; ukukhululwa kwezondlo kuthatha ixesha.
Sebenzisa izigqubuthelo zexesha ezifanelekileyo, izihlahla ezixhasayo nemithi yethutyana.
Lawula ukuxinana kwezixhasi njengoko izityalo zikhula; akukho nani lilodwa elisebenza kuyo yonke imithi yeziqhamo.

quiz.q: I-nitrogen ekwimpahla ye-legume esikiweyo ifumaneka nini kwezinye izityalo?
options: Kwangoko xa isikiwe
Njengoko izidalwa eziphila emhlabeni ziyibola le mpahla
Kuphela xa umthi weziqhamo uchukumisa i-legume
Ayinakuze ifumaneke
quiz.rationale: Ukubola kukhulula izondlo ngokuhamba kwexesha. Isantya sixhomekeke kuhlobo lwempahla nakwiimeko zokukhula.

quiz.q: Yintoni ekufanele igqibe ngenani lezityalo ezixhasayo ozimisayo?
options: Inani elinye elimiselweyo kuyo yonke indawo
Amanzi, umhlaba, ubukhulu besityalo nenkathalo onokuyinika
Ukuhlala ubeka yonke inkxaso ngaphezulu ethambekeni
Ukutyala imithi emininzi kangangoko ingena ngokwenyani
quiz.rationale: Izityalo ezixhasayo nazo zifuna izixhobo nokulawulwa. Khangela ukukhula nokhuphiswano, uze uhlengahlengise.

lessons.title: Izityalo zengca yokugquma kunye nezinambuzane eziluncedo
lessons.body:
Iklip ibonisa ukusikwa kwesebe: umthi ongumxhasi usemi. Shiya amagqabi anempilo anele ukuze isityalo siphinde sibuyele kwimeko.

Lungelelanisa ukusika nohlobo lwesityalo. Phepha ukusika kakhulu rhoqo kwi-pigeon pea, ingakumbi xa uyityala ukuze uvune ii-pea.

Ingca yokugquma ikhusela umphezulu, inceda ukugcina ukufuma kwaye ibuyisela impahla yezinto eziphilayo.

Shiya indlela yokufikelela ekunisweni nasekuhlolweni. Sika impahla ibe ziziqwenga ezilawulekayo uqhubeke ujonga ukufuma nokubola.

Fumana i-cultivar (uhlobo olukhethiweyo) echanekileyo. I-Bocking 14 ayisasazeki ngembewu ekwaziyo ukuhluma, kodwa iziqwenga zengcambu zinokuphinda zihlume.

Yibeke apho inendawo nokufuma okwaneleyo. Sika amagqabi njengoko ibuyela kwimeko; ungawuxinezeli umthi weziqhamo oselula.

Uninzi lwee-ladybird (iinambuzane ezincinci ezinamachokoza) ludla ii-aphid (iinambuzane ezincinci ezifunxa ijusi yezityalo); ezinye ii-parasitoid wasp (iinambuzane ezinjengeenyosi ezihlasela ezinye izinambuzane) zihlasela izinambuzane ezonakalisa izityalo. Izityalo ezidubulayo ezinjenge-African basil zinokongeza izixhobo.

Jonga ukuba zeziphi izinambuzane ezityelelayo nokuba umonakalo uyatshintsha na. Isityalo esidubulayo asiqinisekisi ulawulo lwezinambuzane ezonakalisayo.

I-Tulbaghia violacea inamagqabi amancinci amxinwa kunye neentyatyambo ezimfusa ezikhaphukhaphu (lilac). Beka iqela lezityalo apho linokukhanya nendawo yokukhula.

Jonga izinambuzane ezityelelayo. Ungathembisi ukuba isangqa se-wild garlic uza kugxotha izinambuzane ezonakalisayo okanye uphilise ukuqhambuka kwazo.
keyPoints: Ukunqunqa kusika amasebe ngoxa kugcinwa isityalo esixhasayo.
Buyisela amagqabi asikiweyo afanelekileyo njengengca yokugquma ngoxa usigcina isiqu sicocekile.
I-Bocking 14 ayisasazeki ngembewu ekwaziyo ukuhluma, kodwa iziqwenga zengcambu zinokuphinda zihlume.
Izityalo ezidubulayo zinokuxhasa izinambuzane eziluncedo; jonga indlela ezityelela ngayo ngokwenyani nomonakalo wesityalo.

options: Ukususa wonke umthi ongumxhasi
Ukunqunqa umthi ongumxhasi ogcinwayo ukuze kufumaneke ukukhanya nengca yokugquma
Ukuvuna umthi weziqhamo
Ubungqina bokuba ukhuphiswano lwengcambu luyekile
quiz.rationale: Isebe liyawa, ngoxa umthi ongumxhasi usemi. Oko kukunqunqa kunye ne-chop-and-drop (ukusika uyiyeke iwe emhlabeni).

quiz.q: Unokuzivavanya njani izityalo ezidubulayo ezisetyenziselwa ukuxhasa izinambuzane eziluncedo?
options: Cinga ukuba ziza kuphelisa izinambuzane ezonakalisayo
Jonga izinambuzane ezityelelayo notshintsho kumonakalo wesityalo
Susa zonke iintyatyambo phambi kokuba zivuleke
Bala yonke into edubulayo njengesityalo esifaka i-nitrogen
quiz.rationale: Iintyatyambo zinokubonelela ngezixhobo, kodwa ubukho bazo abuqinisekisi ulawulo lwezinambuzane ezonakalisayo.

lessons.title: Yakha i-guild uyihlengahlengise njengoko ikhula
lessons.body:
Dibanisa imisebenzi yenkxaso efunwa yindawo yakho: ukufaka i-nitrogen, ukutya, ingca yokugquma, iintyatyambo nesigqubuthelo somhlaba. Ezinye izityalo zenza imisebenzi emininzi.

Gcina indawo yesiqu nendlela ivuliwe. Phinda uhlole ilungu ngalinye njengoko i-mango kunye nabamelwane bayo bekhula.

Gcina iziqu zayo ezirhubuluzayo zikude nomthi weziqhamo oselula kwaye ugcine indlela yokuyinakekela. Iingcambu zayo nazo zisebenzisa amanzi nezondlo.

Apho izixhobo zinqongophele, qhathanisa isigqubuthelo esiphilayo nebheseni eqhelekileyo yengca yokugquma.

Tyala ngexesha elifanelekileyo, gquma ngengca uze ugcine amanzi okumisa isityalo. Gcina isikhewu sokufikelela sivuliwe.

Qala ngenani lezityalo ezixhasayo onokuzinakekela. Jonga ukusinda nokukhula phambi kokongeza ezinye.

Sika phantsi izixhasi ezikhethiweyo ezikhuphisanayo ukuze uvule indawo. Impahla esikiweyo efanelekileyo inokuhlala njengengca yokugquma: oku kukunciphisa nge-chop-and-drop.

Lawula ukuhluma kwakhona ukuze ugcine ivuliwe indawo. Hlola ukukhanya, ukufuma komhlaba nokukhula; ukunciphisa akuyeki ngoko nangoko ukhuphiswano lwengcambu.

Buyisela iinqunqo eziluncedo kwimithi esele imisiwe. Gcina izityalo ezikufutshane kuphela apho zisenza kakuhle.

Imithi yeziqhamo esele ikhulile isafuna izondlo. Jonga ukukhula, isivuno nemeko yomhlaba; izityalo ezixhasayo aziyisusi loo mfuno.

Hlola ukukhula komthi weziqhamo, umthunzi, ukufuma komhlaba, izivuno eziluncedo nomonakalo ngezinambuzane ezonakalisayo. Bhala oko kusikiweyo, kubuyiselwe okanye kususiwe.

Sebenzisa ezi ngqwalaselo ukutshintsha uyilo nenkathalo. Isityalo sifumana indawo yaso ngoko sikwenzayo apha.
keyPoints: Nika isityalo ngasinye indima eluncedo ngoxa ukhusela indawo yomthi weziqhamo.
Isigqubuthelo somhlaba esiphilayo sikhuphisana nokunye ngamanzi nezondlo.
Nciphisa izityalo ezixhasayo ezipheleleyo ezikhethiweyo xa ukunqunqa kungasanikezi ndawo yaneleyo.
Impahla esikiweyo efanelekileyo inokuhlala njengengca yokugquma; lawula ukuhluma kwakhona ukuze ugcine indawo evuliweyo.

quiz.q: Isityalo esixhasayo sisawuxinezela i-mango emva kokunqunqa. Ukunciphisa kungabandakanya ntoni?
options: Ukusika kuphela enye intonga encinci
Ukusika phantsi isixhasi esikhethiweyo esikhuphisanayo nokulawula ukuhluma kwakhona
Ukususa i-mango endaweni yoko
Ukuhlala uthatha yonke impahla esikiweyo uyisusa kwindawo
quiz.rationale: Ukunciphisa kunciphisa izityalo ezixhasayo ezikhethiweyo ezimeleyo. Impahla esikiweyo efanelekileyo inokuhlala njengengca yokugquma.

quiz.q: Ngaba ubhatata uhlala ungcono kunebheseni yengca yokugquma ejikeleze umthi weziqhamo oselula?
options: Ewe, kuba akasoze asebenzise amanzi
Ewe, kuba ufaka i-nitrogen
Hayi; qhathanisa iinzuzo zawo zokutya nesigqubuthelo nokhuphiswano lwezixhobo
Hayi, kuba akukho sigqubuthelo somhlaba sinokuluncedo
quiz.rationale: Khetha isigqubuthelo ngokwendawo. Gcina indlela yokufikelela nendawo yesiqu icocekile, uze ujonge umthi oselula.
